about.title: Who is behind BIT
about.lead: Stefan Bogdanovic · owner and main contact · Zurich
body: I know day-to-day operations from hotel and front-desk environments and the everyday user, access and system questions small businesses face.

BIT supports small businesses without in-house IT with user accounts, Microsoft 365, access and recurring workplace issues. I work as an operational contact — not as a general IT expert for every issue, and not as an expert team.
Working languages for this Swiss IT site: German and English. Other languages by agreement or with external language support.
about.pilot: BIT currently reviews selected requests within a limited introductory operation.

faq.meta_description: Common questions about BIT’s scope, audience and way of working.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: Is BIT an in-house IT department?
items.a: No. BIT takes structured ownership of clearly scoped user, access and workplace requests, documents them and follows them through. Scope is agreed in writing first.
Smaller companies with about 5–50 employees, mostly on Windows and Microsoft 365, without a dedicated IT role — Zurich and remote across Switzerland.

items.q: Can every IT problem be covered?
items.a: No. I first check whether your need fits the defined service frame. Complex or vendor-dependent cases are reviewed before work starts and only continued by agreement.

items.q: Does BIT only work with hotels?
items.a: No. Hotels and front desk are one experience example. The offer is aimed at smaller Swiss companies without in-house IT.
It depends on the case and the written agreement. Where a task sits outside my own scope, I check first whether a suitable external specialist can be involved.
Permission and access changes only happen after documented approval and within the written scope.

items.q: Are there fixed packages or prices?
items.a: There are guideline rates (working time CHF 120 per hour). The IT basics check is a fixed-price entry from CHF 190 with a written finding and priorities. Most requests are handled remotely. If an on-site appointment is required, it is agreed in advance and listed separately in the quote — Zurich area. Prices become binding only after written review of scope.
